webdav.title: WebDAV & Storage
webdav.sectionDesc: Drop files from your PC or phone straight into the server data directory. You can also sync reading progress, import local books, and export backups in the Legado format.
webdav.builtInHint: Built into the server, no extra port or container required
webdav.authHint: Any username, password is your current login password
webdav.syncDesc: Reads and writes back to Legado mobile progress folders. Uses the newer of database and progress file when opening a book, and updates progress file upon every chapter turn.
webdav.syncFolderHint: Relative to WebDAV root. Legado mobile app default is typically legado/bookProgress (nested subdirectories supported).
webdav.syncConfigSaved: Progress folder set to {{dir}} (found {{count}} progress files)
webdav.syncConfigSavedNotExists: Saved as {{dir}}, but folder does not exist yet. It will be created on next sync
webdav.syncFolderPending: Path {{path}}/{{name}} not created yet. Will be auto-created on first sync
webdav.localBooksHint: Supports TXT and EPUB formats with multi-select. TXT automatically detects charset (UTF-8 / GB18030) and splits chapters; EPUB parses built-in TOC and covers. Imported books appear on your shelf.
webdav.emptyDirectory: This directory is empty. Click "Upload File" in the top right to get started.
webdav.importBackupTitle: Import sources, replace rules, shelf books and progress from Legado backup archive
webdav.importBookToShelfTitle: Import this book into your shelf (TXT / EPUB only)
webdav.securityHint: WebDAV uses HTTP Basic authentication. Use HTTPS reverse proxy for public deployment, and increase client_max_body_size for large files.
webdav.clipboardNotSupported: Clipboard not supported in this environment, please copy manually
webdav.onlyTxtEpub: Only TXT / EPUB formats supported, ignored {{count}} files
webdav.deleteEntryConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{target}} "{{name}}"? {{extra}}
webdav.deleteDirExtra: Contents inside will also be deleted.
webdav.importBackupConfirm:
Import backup "{{name}}"?
This will import sources, replace rules, shelf, groups, bookmarks and reading progress.

Local books and audiobooks will be skipped.
webdav.backupEmptyWarning: No importable content in backup package (RSS / TTS / themes ignored) {{skipNote}}
webdav.backupImportSuccessSummary: Import completed: sources {{sources}}{{sourceGroupNote}}, rules {{rules}}, books {{books}}, progress {{progress}}{{markNote}}{{skipNote}}
webdav.exportDesc: Exports book sources and their groups, bookshelf and book groups, and reading progress in the Legado backup format into the path below. The zip shows up in File Manager for download, and can also be pulled by the mobile app over WebDAV.
webdav.exportHint: Relative to the WebDAV root; empty means the root (subdirectories supported). The device name is appended after the date, e.g. backup2026-09-30-web.zip; leave it empty for a date-only name.
webdav.exportBackupTitle: Export sources and groups, bookshelf and groups, and reading progress in the Legado backup format
webdav.autoExportHint: Only the newest file is kept per day and device name (a new backup overwrites the old one). Toggles take effect immediately.
webdav.autoExportMasterHint: Master switch — turning it off disables all three options below
webdav.scheduledTimeSaved: Scheduled export time saved: daily at {{time}}
webdav.scheduledTimeInvalid: Time must be HH:mm on a 24-hour clock, e.g. 03:00
